title: Multivariate genome-wide analysis of sarcopenia reveals genetic comorbidity with urological diseases.

evidence_spans.quote: Sarcopenia is a prevalent age-related disorder

scope_reviewer.concise_rationale: The report presents new human genetic analyses of sarcopenia and urological diseases. Although sarcopenia is described as age-related, the current analysis is framed around disease genetics and comorbidity rather than an explicitly analyzed aging process.
